      Viking

      A VIKING LEADERSHIP ROLE As a Viking Shipboard Leader, you represent Viking's values and leadership philosophy (Hávamál). You are a hospitality professional who demonstrates passion for excellence, who takes ownership for your areas of responsibility, and who believes in empowering your team with the skills, knowledge and tools to succeed. You are an exceptional role model for the Viking Family and have strong motivation to achieve the company's goals and objectives. You are flexible, stress resistant, focused, and a truly committed team member. PURPOSE OF POSITION -The Head Waiter assists the Restaurant Manager to ensure efficient food and beverage (F&B) operations and maintains productivity, quality, and guest-service standards in accordance with Viking's STAR Service Standards. -You are required to be self-motivated and run outlets independently, continuously making the effort to coach and develop the Restaurant Team. -It is your responsibility to create a friendly, guest-orientated service culture to ensure Guest satisfaction and repeat business, which in turn, will increase revenue and profitability of the company. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES -Plan, schedule and assign staff to their relevant sections, accordingly; assist the Restaurant Manager with conducting daily menu presentations and organizing & executing F&B related ship functions and special events; greet and welcome Guests and check on their well-being, while on duty. -Manage and control Guest reservations and seating, when instructed; communicate Guest allergies and special needs to relevant parties. -Ensure professional and efficient communication with the Executive Chef, Galley Team and Bar Team. -Conduct accurate monthly inventory's and assist the Restaurant Manager with creating durable orders. -Work within set restaurant-cost budgets; manage tasks related to inventory; conduct stock takes. -Manage and control Restaurant Pest Management Logs in accordance with all Public Health Policies. -In conjunction with the Restaurant Supervisor, regularly update the Restaurant Manager about the performance of the Restaurant Team; identify opportunities to improve service delivery in accordance with Viking's STAR Service Standards, by incorporating feedback from the Restaurant Team. -Minimize equipment loss/damage, and maintain immaculate cleanliness standards in relevant areas, by applying safe working policies and procedures, according to all Public Health Policies, and ensuring that all equipment is sanitized and returned accordingly, after each use. -Regularly inspect that the mise-en-place for all areas are prepared 15 minutes prior to service. -Plan, schedule and assign staff to their relevant sections, accordingly; monitor the Time & Attendance System, in accordance to Maritime Labor Convention (MLC) 2006. -Lead and support a multi-cultural team, maximizing crew satisfaction, productivity and retention; meet with Team Leaders on a daily basis for "The Daily Reunion", to provide feedback & operational updates as well as to ensure that your department is performing to Viking's STAR Service Standards. -Regularly inspect that the mise-en-place for all areas are prepared 15 minutes prior to service. -Provide the highest level of comfort and service to Guests, as per Viking's STAR Service Standards and all Public Health Policies; manage service according to Guest flow, embarkation & disembarkation, sea day activities & other activities. -Identify potential STARS, and assist, train & lead them to success; implement and motivate a culture off ownership & responsibility and provide the necessary guidance/training and information to the Restaurant Team, in accordance with company standards and operational needs.

    • Data Analyst – Jr Data Scientist (Madrid - Híbrido)

      PEPPER

      • Madrid
      • Híbrido
      • 08 jul

      Somo Pepper, empresa líder global en servicios de financiación al consumo. Únete a nuestro equipo de Data & Advanced Analytics, donde los datos y la IA son el corazón de las decisiones estratégicas de la compañía. Buscamos un perfil híbrido entre Data Analyst y Data Scientist, con más peso en la analítica avanzada que en el Machine Learning puro. No se trata de construir scorings ni de poner modelos de ML en producción - de eso se encarga el equipo de Risk Credit and Intellegence - sino de explorar datos, montar MVPs de cara a negocio y prototipar ideas y modelos que después se traspasan a ese equipo para su industrialización. Es una posición ideal para alguien con poca experiencia, pero mucha iniciativa: aquí se prueban cosas nuevas constantemente, se trabaja de forma autónoma y se aprende rápido, en un entorno exigente donde no se penaliza el error, sino la falta de curiosidad. Funciones, ¿Qué harás en tu día a día? - Explorar y analizar grandes volúmenes de datos en SQL Server para identificar patrones, oportunidades y áreas de mejora en negocio. - Desarrollar SQL de todo tipo. - Diseñar y montar MVPs y pruebas de concepto de cara a negocio. - Construir paneles, reportes y cuadros de mando en Power BI para la toma de decisiones. - Testear y prototipar modelos y análisis avanzados. - Apoyarte en LLMs e IA generativa como parte natural del flujo de trabajo. - Monitorizar procesos de negocio, utilizando VS Code como herramienta multiuso para pruebas y tests. - Colaborar con distintos equipos para entender sus necesidades y ofrecer soluciones basadas en datos. Condiciones: - Contrato indefinido. - Jornada completa. - Horario: de L a J de 9:00 a 18:15 y V de 09:00 a 15:00. - Salario: Fijo + variable de hasta el 10% anual. - Modelo híbrido: 3 días de oficina y 2 en remoto, con flexibilidad. - Ubicación oficinas: Madrid capital (CP 28007). - Beneficios sociales: seguro médico y de vida. - Formación interna y externa y acompañamiento en tu desarrollo. - Un entorno puntero: trabajarás con las últimas herramientas del ecosistema de datos e IA (SQL Server, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, LLMs) y con acceso a grandes volúmenes de información.
